name: Mark Virchenko
description: Mark Virchenko is the founder and CEO of RedDuck, a blockchain engineering and consulting firm based in Limassol, Cyprus. He works on wallet security and DeFi infrastructure, and his main focus is blind signing: users approving transactions they can’t actually read. Mark and his team created ERC-8009 (Proxy Clear Signing), an open-source standard that shows users the balance changes a transaction will cause before they sign it. They have built working demos on Trezor and Ledger hardware wallets.
